premises.text: Existing water heaters waste water, are hard to temperature-control, inefficient, and break as elements overheat
premises.evidence_span: Existing hot water heating technology doesn't save water. It's difficult to control the temperature. It's not energy efficient and the things inside that get really hot to heat the water break when they get really hot

premises.text: Electronic controls plus water's resistance heat water instantly without heating elements or burners
premises.evidence_span: using electronic controls and the natural resistance of the water itself to heat the water instantly without any heating elements or burners

premises.text: Wi-Fi and an iOS app set temperatures and presets; utilities can cap peak power draw
premises.evidence_span: our electronic controls are natural for Wi-Fi connectivity. So through our iOS app on the front page, you can actually adjust temperature settings and presets

premises.text: The Model 1 saves substantial household energy and water versus conventional heating
premises.evidence_span: The Model 1 will save 24% of the energy you use and 20% of the water

premises.text: Model 1 installs as booster, extender, or turbocharger on existing systems, opening a retrofit market
premises.evidence_span: The Model 1 is the only product that you can install in your existing hot water system that will augment its performance

value.text: Proactively save water and energy with reliable, luxurious water heating
value.evidence_span: proactively save water and energy while getting a reliable and luxurious water heating experience

causal_links.evidence_span: Instant water heating saves water, 99 plus percent energy efficient

notes: Booster/extender/turbocharger listed uses folded into one retrofit-applications premise (§4.1(2)/(5)). Market-size and Kickstarter traction excluded. Blue Rhino biography excluded. Body-mass shower demo treated as future UX vision detail inside product, not a separate premise.
